what.text: This page follows refugees from Moldova in all host countries, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 5846 Moldovan refugees, and Germany hosted 34.2% of them.
After Germany, the largest hosts are the United States, France and Romania.

why.text: UCDP records one armed conflict for Moldova: over Dniestr territory with the PMR in 1992.
The fact pack does not give other reasons why people left Moldova.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1993 at 5 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 12065, at the end of 2005.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2002 to 2006, 2010 to 2012 and 2024.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
